purpose: One versioned visual metadata contract for Admin Content Studio, student web, Android, source extraction and human review.

visual_kinds.label: Photo
visual_kinds.presentation: responsive image with contain fit, alt text, caption and source attribution

visual_kinds.label: Illustration
visual_kinds.presentation: responsive image with contain fit, alt text, caption and source attribution

visual_kinds.label: Diagram
visual_kinds.presentation: responsive labelled figure; zoom/open affordance; alt text and source attribution

visual_kinds.label: Chart / graph
visual_kinds.presentation: source figure image with axes/units explained in the description and meaningful alt text

visual_kinds.label: Table / comparison
visual_kinds.presentation: source figure image with a text equivalent or summary in the description

visual_kinds.label: Infographic
visual_kinds.presentation: responsive composite image with an explanatory caption and alt text

visual_kinds.label: Sequence / process
visual_kinds.presentation: pauseable MP4/WebM when animated; GIF/WebP on Android 9+ with a static fallback on Android 8.1 and older, otherwise a reviewed static image

visual_kinds.label: Unclassified textbook figure
visual_kinds.presentation: review-only placeholder category; cannot be published

publication_rules: A V3 candidate is never automatically approved or published.

A source-derived visual requires a reviewer-approved category, meaningful alt text, complete book/page/SHA-256 provenance, visual_review_status=APPROVED, and rights_status=LICENSE_CONFIRMED before its lesson can be published.
Only users with CONTENT_REVIEW may approve a candidate or confirm publication rights.
Existing lesson JSON without candidate metadata follows the existing media-block validation rules.

candidate_pipeline.input: immutable whole-book PDF and matching extraction manifest
candidate_pipeline.output: V3 review candidate pack, compact review-only catalog and content-addressed media preview URLs
candidate_pipeline.matching_policy: match page/figure to the actual course lesson concept and verify against extracted page context; never attach candidates merely because they appear in sequence
candidate_pipeline.storage: large complete candidate packages remain in GHCR; selected review previews and catalog metadata are versioned in GitHub
